div.div: أَصْبَرُ [More, and most, patient or enduring]. أَصْبَرُ مِنْ حِمَارٍ [More patient than an ass] is a prov. (Meyd.) And one says, هُوَ أَصْبَرُ عَلَى الضَّرْبِ مِنَ الأَرْضِ (tropical:) [He is more patient of beating than the ground]. (A.) [The fem.] صُبْرَى is applied to a she-camel by Honeyf El-Hanátim [as meaning Surpassingly patient or enduring]. (IAar, TA in art. بهى.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
